features: GTA VI theme, now the default: animated sunset Home, a neon night-drive player background and a vinyl disc player
Dune Rise is the new default font

Pattukal Wrapped redesigned as a story: your minutes, your #1 song on a spinning record, your top artist, then a top-11 grid where you pick songs and Play, Play next or add to queue. New listeners get recommended songs
Time Fold now opens full screen in liquid glass, with many more songs and Play next on every card

Now Playing edit mode: tap the pencil to restyle the artwork, play buttons, progress bar, glow and accent colour right on the player, drag things where you like, save your own builds and reset anytime
Endless playback: when a song, playlist or search finishes, Pattukal keeps adding related songs automatically
Spotify shortcut on Home to connect and import playlists, and your Spotify playlists appear on Home
Winter mode (Midnight, snow, water fill) and separate Overlay effects, reachable from Settings > Appearance
Pattukal Blue app icon everywhere, with blue notification accents

Audio quality tiers (Low / Medium / High / Lossless / Dolby Atmos) with MB per hour, set separately for Wi-Fi and mobile data. Low really drops to ~64 kbps. High and above ask your addon servers first; YouTube is the fallback

Player settings: optional 32-bit float audio output (off by default) and an Output info line showing the real format Android opened (sample rate, 16-bit or float). Output display idea credited to Auris / BitChord
bug_fixes: Fixed the Settings Back button so you can leave Settings without the cross
Home rows no longer reshuffle or jump while you scroll or refresh
Fixed the player edit button hiding under the status bar
